meta.parties: Commissioner of Stamps v. Dickapttiya Tea and Rubber Co., Ltd

rules.statement: An interest in immovable property, even when subject to a trust for sale and not yet converted into money, is liable to estate duty where the property was situated out of the United Kingdom at the time of death.
rules.supporting_quote: "For all the purposes of the administration of the trust the property in this case can be regarded as situated in England even before it was sold and therefore liable to estate duty there, but can this alter the character of immovable property which Dickapitiya estate has under our law?"
